a.  Community and Cultural Development Committee - Declarable conflict of interest - Item 5- Councillor Liam Mooney - requested it be noted that he is a member of the Performing Arts Community in Townsville, has a previous relationship with TheatreiNQ and has written previous letters of support for the company as well as other performing arts companies in Townsville.

b.  Community Health, Safety and Environmental Sustainability Committee - Declarable conflict of Interest - Item 8 - The Mayor, Councillor Jenny Hill is a member of the Policy Executive for the northern branch of the Local Government Association of Queensland ("LGAQ") and through that has also been appointed to the Board of the LGAQ. The Mayor noted that while the LGAQ has received funding, she is not involved in the decision making around who receives the funding.

c.  Infrastructure Services Committee - Disclosure of Various Matters - Item 16 - Councillor Suzanne Blom - Councillor Blom advised of the following: "I wish to note that I am a Life Member of the North Devils Junior Club. I have not been appointed to an executive officer position on that Club, nor has any related party of me. Accordingly, I do not consider I have any conflict of interest in this particular matter and believe that section 150EO(1)(B)(i) or (ii) of the Local Government Act applies."

(i)   Councillor Ann-Maree Greaney - 
        That Council investigate the existing arrangements and performance/success of the St John’s
        Lawn Mowing Program for affected residents and that a report be provided back to full
        Council for consideration.


(ii)  Councillor Fran O'Callaghan -
        That Council reintroduce the mowing voucher program and fund it to the same level as it was
        in the 2020/2021 financial year.


(iii)   Councillor Fran O'Callaghan - 
       That no individual or club is to have a sole use permit for recreational activity on either:

       a.  Black Weir Ross River and that the booking system now in use in areas A & B is to also
            include section D
           
            or

       b. Ross Lake and that a booking system similar to the TCC Black Weir booking system is to be
            utilised with the maximum booking period and number of simultaneous users to be
            determined

        and that Clubs requiring the water for events for a day or weekend are to have equal
        entitlements to bookings with total club bookings not to exceed more than 18 weekends
        a year.

      i)    the budget for the project

      iii)  the original project period and any forecast change to that project period
      iv)  the expenditure to date on the project 
      v)   the forecast cost to complete of the project detailing any agreed or forecast variations to the project


(ii)   Councillor Fran O'Callaghan -
